doc.digest: Output numbers by moving a dial onscreen
doc.description: live.dial works like a circular slider that outputs numbers according to its degree of rotation.

methods.name: bang
methods.digest: Send the current value out the outlet
methods.description: Sends the current value out the outlet.

methods.name: int
methods.digest: Store, display, and output a value
methods.description: The number received in the inlet is stored and displayed by the live.dial object and sent out the outlet.

methods.name: float
methods.digest: Store, display, and output a value
methods.description: The number received in the inlet is stored and displayed in the live.dial and sent out the outlet.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: The word assign, followed by a floating point value, causes that value to be displayed and sent out the live.dial object's outlet. The value, however, will not be stored. If the Parameter Visibility attribute is set to Stored Only, the assign message will not add the new value to the Live application’s undo chain.

methods.name: init
methods.digest: Restore and output the initial value
methods.description: Restores and outputs the initial value.

methods.name: (mouse)
methods.digest: Click and drag to change the dial value.
methods.description: Click and drag in the dial to change the value. Hold down the Shift key for more precise mouse control.

methods.name: outputvalue
methods.digest: Send the current value out the outlet
methods.description: Sends the current value out the outlet.

methods.name: rawfloat
methods.digest: Store a raw normalized value, convert to real, display, and output
methods.description: A raw normalized value (between 0. and 1.) received in the inlet is converted to a real value, stored, displayed by live.dial, and the current value is sent out the outlet.

methods.name: set
methods.digest: Set a value without causing output
methods.description: Sets the current value without causing any output.
